en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Zureys Al Kunasy, 
Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘The one who carries the weapon at night, so he is a combatant, except if he happens to be a man who is not from the doubtful people’.
